item.title: My New Flat
item.summary: A student describes her small new flat, her quiet street and the places near her building.
item.transcript_text: Hi, I'm Kamola. I'm a student, and last month I moved into a new flat. It's small, but I love it. There's one bedroom, a living room and a little kitchen. My bedroom has a big window, so it's very light in the morning. My flat is on the third floor. There's no lift, so I walk up the stairs every day. My street is quiet, and there are lots of trees. There's a bakery next to my building. And the metro station is only five minutes away.
